faqs.question: What is Comprehensive Car Insurance?
faqs.answer: It provides protection against third-party liabilities and damages to your own vehicle.

faqs.question: Does insurance cover flood damage?
faqs.answer: Most comprehensive plans include flood and natural disaster coverage.

faqs.question: What is Zero Depreciation Cover?
faqs.answer: It minimizes depreciation deductions during claim settlement.

faqs.question: Can I transfer insurance when selling my vehicle?
faqs.answer: Yes, ownership and policy transfer procedures are available.
